verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data export feature, account-data download, or open-format export path for DeepInfra. OpenAI-compatible endpoints and no long-term contracts may make switching providers easier, but they are adjacent portability traits, not a capability to export your data. The zero-retention policy is a privacy control, not an export mechanism.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
